AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Wait a few seconds and try again.
AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE.message: The AI provider hit a temporary error.

AI_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.hint: Workers AI usage resets at midnight UTC. If this account should be on Workers Paid, check in the Cloudflare dashboard that the Paid plan is attached to the account this Worker runs in (AI > Workers AI shows the usage state).
AI_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED.message: The AI allowance for today is used up.

AI_REQUEST_FAILED.hint: Try again, or rephrase the request.
AI_REQUEST_FAILED.message: The AI request did not complete.

BAD_REQUEST.hint: Check the values you sent and try again.

BROWSER_CAPACITY.hint: Browser capacity is limited and shared. Wait a minute and retry.
BROWSER_CAPACITY.message: No browser session is available right now.

CONFLICT.message: That conflicts with the current state.

INTERNAL.hint: The failure was logged. Try again in a moment; if it repeats, quote the time it happened.
INTERNAL.message: Something went wrong on the server.

NOT_FOUND.hint: It may have been deleted, or the link is out of date.

PUBLIC_NOT_CONNECTED.hint: Paste a Public.com access token in the Public tab first.

PUBLIC_NO_TOOLS.hint: Check the connected account has API access, then reconnect the token.
PUBLIC_NO_TOOLS.message: Public.com returned no tools for this account.

PUBLIC_UPSTREAM.hint: The token may have expired, or Public.com is having trouble. Reconnect the token or try again shortly.

RATE_LIMITED.hint: Wait a moment and try again.

SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED.hint: Create the AI Search instance (default name: cfpay) in the Cloudflare dashboard under AI > AI Search.
SEARCH_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: Knowledge search is not configured yet.

UNAUTHORIZED.hint: Enter your API key in the dashboard sign-in and try again.
UNAUTHORIZED.message: You are not signed in, or the API key is not valid.

UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.message: A service this depends on took too long to answer.

VALIDATION_FAILED.hint: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
VALIDATION_FAILED.message: One of the values was not valid.
